course_description: Students will learn about media studies and cultural studies frameworks to analyze popular media throughout the century. Students write in class daily, blog to larger audiences weekly, draft and revise multiple multimodal projects, and respond meaningfully to peers' work in structured workshops.
course_notes: The US Black Press at 200 - In 1827, Freedom's Journal became the first newspaper owned, edited, and published by Black Americans in the United States. In spring of 2027, we will celebrate this important 200th anniversary for Black print culture by exploring the history and development of newspapers, magazines, and other print genres created by and for Black people across North America. We'll read literary magazines, abolitionist newspapers, fiction from periodicals, and more! across almost a century of print culture. Assignments include media literacy flowchart, "News in the News" presentation, and a long-term Wikimedia project contributing metadata and original Wikipedia articles about the US Black press.
